summary: Iteration 6 frontend-only test. PRIMARY: Redesigned use-cases section verified end-to-end — 5 pill tabs (usecase-tab-0..4) each swap image (5 distinct URLs), heading (incl. 'Clinics & Healthcare', 'Salons & Spas'), eyebrow (Use case 01..05), stat badge (42% / 3× / 31% / 24/7 / 60%), and floating chat (haircut for salons, Sunday for clinics). Active pill correctly highlighted with slate-ink bg + white text on all 5 tabs. REGRESSION: hero floating chips ('Calls handled this week' at y=154 h=73 and 'New booking confirmed' at y=722 h=59) do not overlap voice-demo (y=247 h=455) at 1920x950. how-it-works step-card-0/1/2 and testimonial-card-0/1/2 auto-cycle (active class length rotates over 2.5s samples). ROI roi-revenue = ₹3,02,400. Pricing annual price-pro = ₹1,599, price-business = ₹5,599; monthly price-pro = ₹1,999. No console or page errors on load.
critical_code_review_comments: UseCases.jsx (~230 lines) is clean and self-contained; keying AnimatePresence by c.key correctly triggers both image and chat crossfade.
Unsplash images have onError -> opacity 0 fallback; the dark gradient overlay behind still provides a graceful visual if any image fails to load.
Consider adding loading='lazy' + width/height on the usecase-image to reduce initial CLS / bandwidth (nice-to-have, non-blocking).
